about: Every line the game shows, with its value on two hosts read on the date above. The old file said team order and awards were standard record-book facts; nothing had been sourced. Round 925 read all 20 old rows and 31 candidates, corrected or removed every line two hosts did not both support, held one candidate out and grew the pool to 50. scripts/simNbaCareerPathFacts.mjs pins the data file to this record word for word.

sources.official: nba.com/player/<id>: the page data (__NEXT_DATA__) gives POSITION, COUNTRY, DRAFT_YEAR, DRAFT_ROUND, DRAFT_NUMBER, ROSTERSTATUS, the current team, the award counts (name and count) and, for a retired player, career per game averages. It does not serve season by season teams or career totals (stats.nba.com refused every request), so those come from the next two.
sources.second: basketball-reference.com player page: Position, birthplace, Draft and Team lines, the Totals table (season, team code, league, career row), the per game career row and the award list at the top of the page.
sources.third: ESPN: the athlete stats feed behind espn.com/nba/player/stats/_/id/<id> (site.web.api.espn.com/apis/common/v3/sports/basketball/nba/athletes/<id>/stats, season rows with a team slug, career totals), and the ESPN awards feed (sports.core.api.espn.com/v2/sports/basketball/leagues/nba/athletes/<id>/awards) for the season of a single MVP, Finals MVP, Rookie of the Year or Defensive Player of the Year.
sources.legends: nba.com Legends profiles, for the two careers ESPN does not hold whole: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar (ESPN keeps no Milwaukee seasons and only offensive plus defensive rebounds, 12,369) and Larry Bird (ESPN keeps no seasons at all).

rules.position: nba.com POSITION word for word when basketball-reference lists a position in every family it names (Guard, Forward, Center). When it does not, only the words both support are shown, in nba.com order: four rows, listed under disagreements.
rules.country: nba.com COUNTRY, which is the country of birth on every row here, matched against the country of the basketball-reference birthplace. The flag is built from the ISO code. One candidate (Dominique Wilkins: nba.com USA, born in Paris, France) failed this and is held out.
rules.draftInfo: 'Nth Round, Nth Pick (YYYY)' with the overall pick, equal on nba.com (round, number, year) and on basketball-reference ('1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 2003 NBA Draft'). The drafting team is not shown.
rules.teams: NBA regular season teams in order, a new entry each time the team or its name changes (Seattle SuperSonics then Oklahoma City Thunder for Durant; New Orleans Hornets then New Orleans Pelicans for Davis), consecutive seasons under one name collapsed. basketball-reference team codes and ESPN team slugs must give the same sequence; the 2005 to 2007 New Orleans/Oklahoma City Hornets seasons (NOK on basketball-reference, nooklahoma-city-hornets on ESPN) show as New Orleans Hornets, the franchise name. Where ESPN does not hold the career, the nba.com Legends profile is the second host. An active player whose current team on nba.com and on basketball-reference is not the last team he played for gets that team appended, so the row is right when the season starts. The current team is the 2026-27 roster team on both hosts; the regular season opens on 2026-10-20 (nba.com key dates). The result screen says how many franchises he played for (the basketball-reference codes, counted by the franchises block); a current team he has not played for yet is never counted, and when its franchise is new to him the line names it as the team he is joining (the shipped row carries lastTeamNotYetPlayed).
rules.stats: Career NBA regular season totals from basketball-reference and ESPN (or the Legends profile). Exact ('26,496 Pts') when the player's last season is before 2025-26 and both agree. A player who played in 2025-26 may still play, so his totals are a floor: the lower of the two values rounded down to a hundred with '+'. Larry Bird shows career per game averages, equal on nba.com and basketball-reference.
rules.awards: Up to four lines. An award line shows a count equal on nba.com and basketball-reference; a single MVP, Finals MVP, Rookie of the Year or Defensive Player of the Year also shows its year when the basketball-reference season and the ESPN awards season agree. The awards an old row named come first when both hosts hold them, then MVP, NBA Champion, Finals MVP, Defensive Player of the Year, All-Star, Rookie of the Year, All-NBA, All-Defensive, Hall of Famer. No scoring or assists titles, Olympic medals, nicknames or 'record' claims: nba.com's player page carries none of them. Counts on active players are as of the read date.
rules.names: The pool spells names without accents so a typed guess matches (Nikola Jokic, Luka Doncic); officialName keeps the nba.com spelling.

franchises.about: A team that moved or changed its name is one franchise. The result screen counts the distinct franchises a player played for: a return stint counts once and a renamed or moved franchise counts once. teamCodes[code].franchise groups the basketball-reference codes the same way, and simNbaCareerPathFacts checks the two agree on every row.

order: The array order is deliberate. The daily pick is dailyIndex(dateET, 50) in src/lib/dateUtils.ts, a fresh shuffle of the pool every 50 days; cycle 414 runs 2026-09-04 to 2026-10-23 and cycle 415 runs 2026-10-24 to 2026-12-12. The 30 new players sit on the 20 indices dealt 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-23 and on the first ten other indices cycle 415 deals, so a release from 2026-10-04 to releaseBy deals only new players for at least its first ten days and leaves at least 14 days between an old player's last old deal and his first new one. The old 20 keep their ids. The day the pool changes, a daily save from that morning loads only if its saved index equals the new one (useDailyPuzzle matches on date and index; this hook passes no puzzle id, and saves written before the release carry none). On 2026-10-31, 2026-12-09 and 2026-12-11 the old and new index are equal while the player differs, so a morning save would load on another player: releaseBy is 2026-10-30 and the release must not land on any of those days.
